name: pigpen-warden
description: Go port of DevMortimer's pi-warden: guardrails that steer instead of interrupt. Holds irreversible tool calls, flags off-task and off-plan calls, breaks stuck loops and asks for verification of unverified done claims. Opt-in, discloses what leaves the machine, and judges with TypeSafe or the session's own model.
author: Michael Kinsy
